def solve(inp):
    bg=max(set(x for r in inp for x in r), key=lambda v:sum(r.count(v) for r in inp))
    h=len(inp); w=len(inp[0])
    pts=[(i,j,v) for i,r_ in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(r_) if v!=bg]
    out=[[inp[rr][cc] for cc in range(w)] for rr in range(h)]
    def owner(rr,cc):
        best=min(pts,key=lambda m:(abs(m[0]-rr)+abs(m[1]-cc),m[0],m[1]))
        return best
    for rr in range(h):
        for cc in range(w):
            if inp[rr][cc]!=bg: continue
            m=owner(rr,cc)
            # cross: rows m.r±1 all cols, or cols m.c±1 all rows — decide by marker layout
            painted = (rr in (m[0]-1,m[0]+1)) or (cc in (m[1]-1,m[1]+1))
            if painted and (rr+cc)%2==(m[0]+m[1])%2: out[rr][cc]=m[2]
    return out
print([solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'] for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5']])
